items.name: scale
items.summary: Resize video frames. A size value of -2 keeps the aspect ratio.

items.name: fps
items.summary: Drop or duplicate frames to reach a constant frame rate.

items.name: split
items.summary: Send one video stream to two filter chains.

items.name: palettegen
items.summary: Build an optimal color palette for a GIF.

items.name: paletteuse
items.summary: Map video frames to a palette. Use it after palettegen.

items.name: trim
items.summary: Keep only the frames between two timestamps.

items.name: setpts
items.summary: Reset frame timestamps to start at zero.

items.name: crop
items.summary: Cut a rectangle from each video frame.

items.name: transpose
items.summary: Rotate video frames. The value 1 rotates 90 degrees clockwise.

items.name: format
items.summary: Convert frames to a pixel format.

items.name: thumbnail
items.summary: Select the most representative frame from each batch.

items.name: subtitles
items.summary: Burn a subtitle file into the video frames.

items.name: loudnorm
items.summary: Normalize loudness to a target level. The EBU R128 target is -16 LUFS.

items.name: dynaudnorm
items.summary: Normalize audio volume in sliding windows.

items.name: volume
items.summary: Change the audio volume by a factor.

items.name: atempo
items.summary: Change audio speed without a pitch change.
